name: JSON Duo
description:
JSON Duo is a dual-pane JSON workbench: paste on the left, see it rendered live on the right. JSON responses from any web page are taken over automatically.

Stop squinting at minified one-line JSON. Once installed, every JSON response turns into a collapsible, syntax-highlighted tree. JSON you copied yourself? Just Ctrl+V into the built-in editor page and the right pane renders it instantly.

KEY FEATURES

- Auto-detect and beautify: takes over application/json and application/*+json responses automatically; hidden JSON in text/plain can be formatted with one click. Zero configuration.

- Dual-pane workbench: paste raw JSON on the left (Ctrl+V, drag & drop .json/.txt, or load the sample), preview live on the right with 220ms debounce. Press F for distraction-free fullscreen.

- Syntax highlighting: keys, strings, numbers, booleans and null in distinct colors. Light and dark themes included, follows your system preference.

- Collapsible tree: collapse or expand any node; fully expanded by default. Collapsed nodes show summaries like "... 13 fields". Huge JSON documents render in chunks as you scroll.

- One-click JSONPath: click any key to copy its full path (e.g. data.list[0].orderId); click a value to copy the value. Great for locating fields, writing assertions and code.

- Escape keep / restore: shows \n and \uXXXX sequences as-is by default so you can read the raw payload; toggle off to restore real characters.

- Beautify / minify and export: the toolbar keeps just 5 buttons: escape keep, theme, beautify/minify, copy, download. Switch to minified single line instantly; copy or download as .json in one click.

- No precision loss: a custom parser (not JSON.parse) preserves the source text. Big integers beyond JS safe range (order IDs, snowflake IDs) like 600653836507516928 are never silently corrupted.

- Error locating: invalid JSON reports the exact line and column with a caret marker; a lenient mode retries tolerating comments, single quotes, trailing commas and unquoted keys.

MULTIPLE ENTRY POINTS

- Automatic formatting when you open a JSON page
- Click the toolbar icon to jump straight into the built-in editor page
- Right-click menu: format this page / format selection / open the editor page
- Keyboard shortcut Alt+Shift+J to toggle formatting and restore
- A dedicated options page for theme, indent width, font size and more

SECURITY AND PRIVACY

- Collects no data, uploads nothing, makes no network requests
- No remote code; all logic ships inside the package
- The viewer runs inside a Shadow DOM, fully isolated from page styles
- Restore the original raw text at any time

FOR WHO

Frontend and backend developers debugging APIs, QA engineers verifying response fields, ops investigating service anomalies, and anyone who needs to quickly read a piece of JSON.
shortDescription: Dual-pane JSON workbench: paste raw JSON, see it rendered live. Syntax highlighting, collapsible tree, JSONPath copy, escape keep/restore, light & dark themes.
